_comment: CoThink driver config. Roles 1 (Strategist) and 8 (Executor) are played by the conductor (Claude) natively; this file configures the engines for roles 2-7.
_models_note: Empty string = the CLI's own default model (recommended — stays current). NOTE: with Codex on a ChatGPT account (not an API key) the *-codex model ids (gpt-5-codex, etc.) are rejected, so leave codex empty and the CLI picks its current default (e.g. gpt-5.6-sol). vibe's model is set in its own config, not via a flag.
_fallbacks_note: Ordered fallback chain per engine — if the preferred engine for a role fails, the driver tries these in order. All six engines are available; assign any to any role above.

durable_memory._comment: Optional: log run summaries/decisions to your OWN context-store REST API across runs. Off by default. Set base_url to your endpoint and export the bearer token in the env var named by token_env.
